Assistant A misreads the third statement, claiming it says bananas cost less than oranges, when it actually says bananas cost more than oranges. From the first two statements we can deduce Bananas > Oranges > Apples, so both parts of the third statement (Bananas > Apples and Bananas > Oranges) are true. Assistant B correctly identifies this and concludes the third statement is true. Therefore, Assistant B provides the accurate and well-reasoned answer.
